# Formula Forum (F³)

> Formula Forum is the national insurance agency growth conference held annually in Orlando, Florida. It is designed for insurance agency owners and producers who want to scale their businesses through actionable strategies, operator-led training, and peer accountability.

## Key Facts

- Full name: Formula Forum 2026
- Abbreviation: F³
- Type: In-person insurance agency growth conference
- Dates: October 14–16, 2026
- Location: JW Marriott Orlando Bonnet Creek Resort & Spa, 14900 Chelonia Parkway, Orlando, FL 32821
- Organizer: Formula Forum (theformulaforum.com)
- Organizer email: Ashleeb@theformulaforum.com
- Organizer phone: 260-515-1349
- Ticket prices: Agency Owner Pass $647, Team Member Pass $347
- Capacity: 250 attendees
- Room block: JW Marriott Orlando Bonnet Creek, $239/night, book at https://book.passkey.com/event/51189838/owner/49980248/home
- Room block cut-off: September 15, 2026
- Website: https://theformulaforum.com

## What Makes Formula Forum Unique (The Format Framework)

Formula Forum uses a proprietary four-step session format called the Format Framework:
1. Speaker (15–20 min): Focused training with actionable insights from real operators.
2. Takeaways (2–3 min): Attendees type out their key takeaways and action items.
3. Breakouts (10 min): Small groups share takeaways and listen to others.
4. Speaker Close (3 min): Solidify training and outline next steps.

Every attendee leaves with a printed "Book of Formulas" playbook containing action maps from every speaker.

## Topics Covered

- Insurance agency scaling and revenue growth
- Referral systems and lead generation
- Producer development and hiring
- Virtual assistant systems and operational efficiency
- AI tools for insurance agencies
- Mindset and leadership development
- Life insurance and financial services strategy
- EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) for agencies
- Community building and networking

## FAQ

Q: Are tickets refundable?
A: No. All sales are final. Tickets may be transferred to another person up to 7 days before the event at no additional cost.

Q: How do I book the hotel room block?
A: Use the room-block link at https://book.passkey.com/event/51189838/owner/49980248/home or call the hotel and mention code F3-2026. The cut-off date is September 15, 2026.

Q: What is the dress code?
A: Business casual is the recommended dress code for all Formula Forum sessions and networking events.

Q: Can I transfer my ticket?
A: Yes, tickets are transferable until October 7, 2026. Contact the Formula Forum team with the new attendee's information.

Q: Is there a group discount?
A: Yes. Teams of five or more save 20% on registration. Email Gregg@theformulaforum.com for a custom group discount code.

Q: What's included in the registration fee?
A: Registration includes access to all sessions, the printed Book of Formulas playbook, networking events, and meals during the conference.

Q: Will sessions be recorded?
A: No. Sessions are not recorded to ensure open, honest discussions and to protect the confidential strategies shared by speakers and attendees.

Q: What should I bring?
A: Bring business cards and a laptop for workshop sessions. All materials and tools will be provided.
